description: Java class implementing a rule engine node for deleting relations between entities in Thingsboard, based on message context and configuration.

classes.name: TbDeleteRelationNode
classes.description: A rule node class for deleting relations between entities based on message and configuration.

methods.name: loadEntityNodeActionConfig
methods.description: Loads and validates the node configuration, supporting single entity delete mode.

methods.name: createEntityIfNotExists
methods.description: Indicates whether to create the target entity if it does not exist (returns false).

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages to trigger relation deletion based on configuration.

methods.name: deleteRelationToSpecificEntity
methods.description: Deletes a relation between the message originator and a specified target entity.
